purpose: Persists rebindable input-keymap overrides in each player's existing PlayerDataStoreService profile and synchronizes authoritative bindings across the client/server boundary with ByteNet.
description: Validates, stores, restores, and reactively applies per-player input bindings without opening another profile session.

Client/InputKeyMapDataStoreClientModel.l.description: Synchronizes one rebindable InputKeyMapList with the local player's persisted binding records. Public entry points include `InputKeyMapDataStoreClientModel.new`, `InputKeyMapDataStoreClientModel.Destroy`.

InputKeyMapDataStoreServiceClient.luau.description: Discovers rebindable keymap lists and owns one persistence model for each list. Public entry points include `InputKeyMapDataStoreServiceClient.Init`, `InputKeyMapDataStoreServiceClient.Start`, `InputKeyMapDataStoreServiceClient.Destroy`.

Shared/InputKeyMapDataStoreServiceConsta.description: Read-only profile-path, payload-bound, rate-limit, and serialized-input-kind constants.

Shared/InputKeyMapDataStoreServiceNetwor.description: ByteNet protocol carrying untrusted binding requests from the local player to the authoritative server.

Shared/InputKeyMapDataStoreServiceTypes..description: Shared serialized-input, binding, request, and persisted-array contracts.

Shared/InputKeyMapDataStoreServiceUtils..description: Validates binding records and profile compatibility, supplies the Squash profile codec, serializes supported input types, verifies input-mode compatibility, finds bindings and keymaps, and immutably applies requests. Public entry points include `InputKeyMapDataStoreServiceUtils.isSerializedInputType`, `InputKeyMapDataStoreServiceUtils.isBinding`, `InputKeyMapDataStoreServiceUtils.isBindingRequest`, `InputKeyMapDataStoreServiceUtils.isBindings`, `InputKeyMapDataStoreServiceUtils.getBindingsSchema`, `InputKeyMapDataStoreServiceUtils.isCompatibleProfileDefinition`, `InputKeyMapDataStoreServiceUtils.serializeInputTypes`, `InputKeyMapDataStoreServiceUtils.deserializeInputTypes`, `InputKeyMapDataStoreServiceUtils.areInputTypesValidForMode`, `InputKeyMapDataStoreServiceUtils.findInputKeyMap`, `InputKeyMapDataStoreServiceUtils.findBinding`, `InputKeyMapDataStoreServiceUtils.applyBindingRequest`, `InputKeyMapDataStoreServiceUtils.areSerializedInputTypesEquivalent`.
